name: Wannamoisett Country Club
architects: Willie Campbell (nine holes, 1899); Donald Ross (18 holes, 1914; revamped 1926)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project RI_Statewide_D22 (2022 USGS Lidar: RI Statewide, QL1, flown 26-30 March 2022), tile x30y464; NAD83 / UTM 19N (EPSG:26919), NAVD88 metres; downloaded by the developer 2026-10-19 (GitHub release data-wannamoisett), clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/clip_raster.py

laz.source: 2022 USGS Lidar: RI Statewide (project RI_Statewide_D22, workunit RI_Statewide_1_D22), QL1, flown 26-30 March 2022 (leaf-off); NAD83(2011) / Rhode Island State Plane (US ft), NAVD88 (GEOID18) US ft; class 1 (unclassified: vegetation and structures; the project has no vegetation classes); tiles downloaded by the developer 2026-10-19 (GitHub release data-wannamoisett)
laz.label: 2022 USGS RI statewide lidar, leaf-off

roof_note: s05: crowns whose returns are >= 85 % last returns are roofs of houses OSM doesn't map (the class-1 points hold structures as well as trees; leaf-off trees let pulses through). The share per crown is bimodal: bare deciduous near 0, pines 0.3-0.8, roofs 0.85-1 (median 6.6 m high, 3 % inside the course).

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (790 x 1,076 m) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,024 m east-west (~117 m each side), 1,280 m north-south (~102 m each side)

join_boundary.note: the pond beside hole 14 is mapped as an inner ring of the course relation (cut out of the course); filled so it is a red penalty area inside the boundary, not out of bounds (developer 2026-10-19)

scorecard_source: No club card yet. Per-hole yardages: GolfPass scorecard (retrieved 2026-10-19): Blue = its 'Blue' column (6,417), Black = its 'Black' column (6,732), which matches the developer's screenshot of a scorecard site (release data-wannamoisett, 'Blue 6732 yds (135/72.8) for Men') number for number. Pars from both (par 69). Stroke index from the developer's screenshot (agrees with OSM on holes 1-9; GolfPass/OpenGolfAPI give another order). Ratings/slopes from the GolfPass tee table: 6,732-yd set 72.8/135 (also on the screenshot), 6,427-yd set 71.3/132 (the GolfPass card prints Black 73.5/130, Blue 71.9/127). The club website now lists Black 6,901 / Blue 6,430 / White 6,132 after new tees were built; per-hole figures for those are not available. Unverified.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2022 USGS Lidar: RI Statewide)
notes: Phase 1 decisions (developer, 2026-10-19): Blue (6,417) default plus Black (6,732, the OSM tee positions); every penalty area red, including the pond by 14; new seekonk theme (early fall: a light yellowing and oranging of some leaves, not full fall). Wind 2-10 mph is the course chat's choice (an inland site near the Seekonk River).
